title: @iflow-mcp/watercrawl-watercrawl-mcp carried GlassWorm's invisible-Unicode loader
summary: An attacker forked the legitimate watercrawl-mcp repository, injected GlassWorm's invisible Unicode decoder after 26 lines of ordinary MCP server setup, and published it to npm under a scope created for the attack, shipping ready-made MCP configuration JSON so a developer could paste it straight into their AI coding tool. Five versions, 1.3.0 through 1.3.4, went out in a single day and every one was malicious from first release.
severity_rationale: An MCP server is handed its credentials by design, and the payload is invisible to review in the editor, so nothing about installing it looks wrong.
